caption: Patrol Activity
description: Patrol Activity events report the execution of guard patrols against their defined routes and schedules. No published standard covers this area; the model here follows the widely used pattern of a tour definition, an occurrence of that tour, and the checkpoint registrations and exceptions recorded within it.
name: patrol_activity

2.caption: Checkpoint Registered
2.description: A checkpoint was registered by the officer on patrol.

3.caption: Tour Completed
3.description: A patrol tour finished with all expected checkpoints registered.

4.caption: Tour Incomplete
4.description: A patrol tour finished with fewer checkpoints registered than expected.

5.caption: Tour Missed
5.description: A scheduled patrol tour did not start.

6.caption: Checkpoint Missed
6.description: An expected checkpoint was not registered.

7.caption: Tour Overrun
7.description: A patrol tour exceeded its expected duration.

8.caption: Geofence Exception
8.description: A checkpoint was registered from outside the defined geofence.

9.caption: Sequence Exception
9.description: A checkpoint was registered outside its expected order.

99.caption: Other
99.description: The event activity is not mapped. See the activity_name attribute, which contains a data source specific value.
